platform: Hybrid: SIMS 7 locally hosted/on-premise; SIMS Next Gen cloud/web; native iOS and Android apps.

distinctive_features.feature: Embedded UK census and statutory financial-return workflows
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Schools can manage important DfE returns and validation within established administrative workflows.
Schools can adopt cloud modules gradually while continuing to use established local workflows.

distinctive_features.feature: MAT Group Hub and configurable Power BI dashboards
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Trust leaders can review cross-school data and apply group-level oversight.

distinctive_features.feature: Broad partner ecosystem with OData APIs and OneRoster
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Documented interfaces and integrator support enable connections to external school systems.

distinctive_features.feature: Connected SIMS, FMS, ParentPay and Schoolcomms services
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: The group portfolio links pupil administration with finance, payments and family communications.

weaknesses.issue: Cloud migration is phased, with some modules still developing or awaiting rollout.
Reviewers describe a dated interface and difficult report or marksheet configuration.
Users report unreliable reports, glitches and slow performance.
Reviewers report poor support experiences and limited troubleshooting resources.
SIMS Parent reviews report login loops, logouts, stalled messages and missing content.
CMA scrutiny and complaints raised concerns about complex or error-prone database transfers; no infringement finding was made.
Pricing is quote-based, with no public official price list.

pricing_model_summary: No official public price list; packages and support tiers require a demo or quote. A third-party estimate exists but is not an official tariff.
biggest_strategic_gap: The cloud rebuild is still phased, leaving schools to manage a transition between established local SIMS 7 and developing Next Gen modules.
